About the game

MapBop is developed by Oyri Games. This page provides information about using the game and store purchases. Development screenshots and features may differ from the final release.

App Store license

For an App Store-distributed version, Apple’s standard end-user license agreement applies unless a different custom license is specified in the store listing. Check the applicable license on the store page where you download the game. Apple Standard EULA ↗

Purchases and virtual content

In purchase-enabled builds, prices and product terms are shown on the store payment screen. Restoring entitlements depends on the same store account and the rules of the relevant product. Check the scope of the offer before purchasing.

Refunds and subscription management

Refunds are reviewed by the store where the purchase was made. Manage any subscriptions through your store account; deleting the app alone does not cancel a subscription. This page does not indicate that a subscription is offered. Apple purchase support ↗
